newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower on rate hike.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower on rate hike.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were sharply lower on Friday in step with the three percentage-point cut in the central bank's overnight borrowing rate to 25 percent, traders said.
But the PHIBOR market continued to see little activity, they said. "It's still very quiet," one trader said.
Players are likely to take positions again when currency and money markets stabilise.
The central bank had started to cut its overnight rates from last week's 2-1/2-year high as the peso showed signs of normalisation.
